name: @repo/voice
description: Voice capability for the Inteligir host: local on-device STT (sherpa-onnx + streaming Parakeet, with the pinned-checksum model downloader) and the ElevenLabs streaming-TTS proxy, plus the voice API-key store over @repo/storage's SecretStore. Host needs (per-user data dir, event emission) are injected via configure seams — this package never imports server/electron code.
